issue_context.title: Breeze: Add 'prepare-image-cache'  in Breeze
issue_context.body:
We have a separate command that prepares image caches. It is very similar to "building image" but:
* it should prepare both prod and CI images
* the `docker build` command should be slighly modified (--cache-to and some other commands)
* validation on whether the `buildx plugin` needs to be performed (and command should fail if not with helpful message)

Those "differences" between standard build-image can be found with `PREPARE_BUILDX_CACHE` variable == "true" usage in old breeze
comments:
Can I pick up this task @potiuk?

Also, build-prod-image have `PREPARE_BUILDX_CACHE ` as part of its function. Does it come under `build-prod-image` or `prepare-image-cache`?

It's overlapping - part of it should be implemented in PROD and part in CI. 

I think the approach of "old breeze" where we had a separate "prepare_buildx_cache" command was not good. The way we have it now in the #21956  is much better - it should be just a flag on "build-ci-image" and "build-prod-image". 

```
./Breeze2  build-ci-image --prepare-buildx-cache
./Breeze2  build-prod-image --prepare-buildx-cache

```

So this one should be more about bringing the `--prepare-buildx-cache` flag to CI build - simlarly as you've alredy done in #21956

@potiuk is `prepare-build-cache` and `prepare-image-cache` means the same?  Also when we send `prepare-build-cache` we also set few other flags. Do we need to follow this and set those flags too?

https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/4a1503b39b0aaf50940c29ac886c6eeda35a79ff/breeze#L1313-L1325
@potiuk I will resume working on this issue once PR #21956 got merged as it will be easier to add code to ci-image and refactor the reusable parts too.

Yes.

Some:
* "FORCE_BUILD_IMAGES" we already dropped it
* "FORCE_ANSWER_TO_QUESTIONS" is not needed (there will be no questions asked).
* "CLEANUP_DOCKER_CONTEXT_FILES" -> yes it should be overwritten to "yes" in this case
* "DOCKER_CACHE" -> yes.
